preconditions.description: The integer k must be between 2 and 12 inclusive.

preconditions.description: Each element in the array a must be a non-negative integer less than 2^k.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Fou' if not any(all(p[i] ^ q[i] == a[i] for i in range(len(a))) for p in permutations(range(2**k)) for q in permutations(range(2**k))) else True

postconditions.expression: all(int(p[i]) ^ int(q[i]) == a[i] for i in range(len(a)))
postconditions.description: The XOR of corresponding elements in the two permutations must equal the elements in the array a.
